facts.claim: 贝尔离开西塔楼后给凯发消息问到达时间，说有话要先在外面给她看。
facts.quote: ETA? Tell me when you’re here so I can come meet you.

facts.claim: 贝尔在楼上小走廊听见抽泣声，发现玛丽莲抱着被砸碎的小提琴坐在塞思怀里。
facts.quote: Marilyn was holding the pieces of what used to be a violin.

facts.claim: 塞思从空乐器架旁的琴盒里抽出楼下那根槌球棒，说玛丽莲午饭前还在拉那把卡莱蒂。
facts.quote: Reaching in, he drew out the croquet mallet from downstairs.

facts.claim: 塞思估算那把卡莱蒂琴值四万美元，玛丽莲纠正说它是无价的，并说吉纳维芙爱那把琴。
凯带着女儿卡罗一同来到甜点庄园，说给贝尔带来一个“粉丝”。
凯告知迪尔德丽的通话记录：没有任何人给她打电话或发短信。
facts.quote: “No one,” said Kay. “Not a single person.”

facts.claim: 贝尔终于向凯坦白自己与卢克·富尔顿的关系，包括前一晚在他家过夜。
facts.quote: It was finally time. And so I told her everything

facts.claim: 凯以贝尔不够坦诚为由，当场把贝尔踢出了这个案子。
facts.quote: I’m sorry, but I’m taking you off the case.

relations.rel: 母女；凯把女儿卡罗带上一趟“公务”行程
relations.quote: Caro released my hand, using it to pat her mother on the head.

relations.rel: 贝尔成了吉纳维芙的不在场证人（案发时两人在一起）
relations.quote: This meant Genevieve was out of it. I was officially her alibi now.

relations.rel: 恋爱关系；贝尔一直对凯隐瞒这段关系
relations.quote: was about my relationship with Luke Fulton

relations.rel: 凯把贝尔招进调查，如今因她隐瞒而将其除名
relations.quote: I brought you into this investigation because you were already embedded here

relations.rel: 塞思抱着受惊的玛丽莲安抚她
relations.quote: Marilyn was half lying in Seth’s arms while he gently rocked her

relations.rel: 母子；被毁的是他母亲最好的一把琴

numbers.claim: 塞思估算被毁的卡莱蒂小提琴价值约四万美元
numbers.quote: Probably for him, this had been the biggest shock of all. “Forty thousand?”

numbers.claim: 贝尔强调今天有人砸了一把四万美元的琴
numbers.quote: someone smashed up a forty-thousand-dollar violin

numbers.claim: 塞思说他们半小时前去吃的午饭
numbers.quote: Seth thought for a second. “A half hour ago? We ate quickly.”

numbers.claim: 音乐室里还有第二架三角钢琴（小型三角钢琴）
numbers.quote: The music room at Sweet Spot had a second grand piano in it

numbers.claim: 房间左侧有六个乐器架
numbers.quote: On the left side of the room were half a dozen instrument stands

numbers.claim: 房间中央有两个谱架相对而立
numbers.quote: Two music stands faced each other in the middle of the room

numbers.claim: 贝尔承认前一晚与卢克发生过三次关系（对凯只字未提）
numbers.quote: how many times we’d had sex (three, for the record)

numbers.claim: 凯提醒贝尔她说过只给两次机会
numbers.quote: I said you got two strikes, no more.

numbers.claim: 凯要求贝尔百分之百坦白、不许有秘密
numbers.quote: I needed you to be one hundred percent open with me

numbers.claim: 迪尔德丽只打出一通电话给假释官
numbers.quote: she made one outgoing call to her parole officer

numbers.claim: 卢克那天周日休息、待在家里
numbers.quote: He was enjoying his Sunday, his day off, at home.

numbers.claim: 贝尔推测勒索可能早在周五之前就已完成
numbers.quote: She could have blackmailed either of them way before Friday!

turning_point: 凯把贝尔叫到西侧崖边，先告知迪尔德丽手机毫无往来记录，随后因贝尔隐瞒与卢克·富尔顿的关系以及吉纳维芙撒谎一事，宣布把贝尔踢出案子——“你被正式除名了”。
notes: 本章无明确日期；时间线索为“午饭前”“半小时前”以及卢克“周日休息”。被毁小提琴的价值存在两种说法：塞思估“四万美元”，玛丽莲称“无价”。
